title: Real-time company fundamentals for Korean & global stocks. Returns market cap, P
description: Real-time company fundamentals for Korean & global stocks. Returns market cap, PER, PBR, ROE, revenue, operating profit, net income, and latest stock price.

_signals.x_guidance: This API provides Korean stock market intelligence packs for AI agents. Call /v1/context/company/{ticker} first for valuation and financials ($0.1). Call /v1/context/issue/{ticker} to understand current news sentiment ($0.1). Call /v1/context/risk/{ticker} before making an investment recommendation ($0.1). Ticker accepts a 6-digit KRX code OR company name in English or Korean (e.g. 005930, samsung, 삼성전자 all resolve to Samsung Electronics). Payment is handled automatically via x402 protocol — send a USDC micropayment on Base Mainnet (eip155:8453) when you receive a 402 response.
